in_marathi.name: Prahlad
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prahlad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Prahlad means 'The Virtuous One', 'Praises Worthy One', 'One Who Praises Vishnu'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prahlaada' which means 'praised, acclaimed, praised, extolled or glorified'. It is the name of a legendary king and a devoted follower of Lord Vishnu. Prahlad is a name that signifies bravery, courage, and loyalty to one's beliefs.
